name: voice-input
title: Voice ↔ Text Input
description: Whimsical voice ↔ text input for the AI category. Type in a shadcn Input, or tap the mic: the field morphs into a listening blob that bounces to the (simulated) sound, puffs out little notes, transcribes what it heard and drops it back into the field. Built on shadcn Input and Button. Hover: the mini blob on the mic button wakes up and waves. Disabled: the blob falls asleep and controls are disabled.
